description:
Desktop proxy client powered by Xray core.

Happ is a application designed for convenient proxy server management, powered by the robust Xray core. The app features an intuitive interface and a range of useful functions, making it an essential tool for managing connections.
* Update Xray Core to 26.6.27
* Improved transport selection: Proxy and TUN now work independently — turn on either or both (shown as “Mixed”) — with a single main-screen dropdown that also picks the TUN provider and stays in sync with Advanced Settings, plus a tray submenu of the providers available on your platform
* Improved app updates to download over your active connection when you're connected
* Improved the built-in Xray core to a newer version
* Improved diagnostic reports to include graphics-driver details
* Added a new single-process Xray built-in TUN provider
* Fixed a freeze when disconnecting TUN
* Fixed a stalled subscription update wiping your saved server list
* Fixed the app failing to launch on macOS 13 and newer
* Fixed selecting Proxy leaving no active transport when the system proxy was off
* Fixed the update changelog text wrapping incorrectly on the About screen
* Improved routing to bundle the latest geoip/geosite data, matching the mobile app, so more routing categories are recognized and stay current
* Fixed the "Geo Files Error" dialog not appearing for a missing geoip/geosite entry after the core update
